steps.command: whoami; cat /etc/os-release | head -5; which nginx || true; ls /etc/nginx 2>/dev/null || true
apt-get update -qq && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq nginx >/tmp/nginx-install.log 2>&1; tail -5 /tmp/nginx-install.log; which nginx; nginx -v 2>&1

nginx -s reload 2>/dev/null || nginx; sleep 1; curl -sS -o /dev/null -w 'index: %{http_code}\n' http://localhost:8080/; curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '404: %{http_code}\n' http://localhost:8080/nonexistent; echo '--- index body ---'; curl -sS http://localhost:8080/; echo '--- 404 body ---'; curl -sS http://localhost:8080/missing; echo '--- process ---'; pgrep -a nginx | head -3; echo '--- logs ---'; ls -l /var/log/nginx/benchmark-*.log; echo '--- recent access ---'; tail -n 3 /var/log/nginx/benchmark-access.log

ps aux | grep [n]ginx || true; echo '--- ports ---'; (ss -ltnp || netstat -ltnp) 2>/dev/null | grep -E ':8080|State' || true; echo '--- curl verbose ---'; curl -v http://localhost:8080/ 2>&1 | head -40; echo '--- default error log ---'; tail -n 20 /var/log/nginx/error.log; echo '--- benchmark error ---'; cat /var/log/nginx/benchmark-error.log; echo '--- perms ---'; ls -ld /var/www /var/www/html; ls -l /var/www/html

curl --noproxy '*' -sS -o /dev/null -w 'index: %{http_code}\n' http://localhost:8080/; curl --noproxy '*' -sS -o /dev/null -w '404: %{http_code}\n' http://localhost:8080/nonexistent; echo '--- index body ---'; curl --noproxy '*' -sS http://localhost:8080/; echo '--- 404 body ---'; curl --noproxy '*' -sS http://localhost:8080/missing; echo '--- access log ---'; tail -n 3 /var/log/nginx/benchmark-access.log; echo '--- config check ---'; grep -nE 'log_format benchmark|limit_req_zone|listen 8080|limit_req |access_log|error_log|error_page|root ' /etc/nginx/nginx.conf /etc/nginx/conf.d/benchmark-site.conf; ls /etc/nginx/sites-enabled
